# ractermx_api_key (Resource)

Manages a RacterMX API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create an API key with scoped permissions.
resource "ractermx_api_key" "ci" {
  name   = "ci-pipeline"
  scopes = ["email:send", "domains:read"]

  expires_at = "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}

output "api_key_id" {
  value = ractermx_api_key.ci.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A descriptive name for the API key. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `scopes` (List of String) List of permission scopes for the API key. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR blocks. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiration date in ISO 8601 format. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key value. Only available on creation; will be empty after import.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the API key was created.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the API key.
- `last_used_at` (String) The timestamp when the API key was last used.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an API key using its numeric ID.
# Note: the api_key value will not be available after import.
terraform import ractermx_api_key.ci 456
```
